verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the API playground page, which states there is no test isolation and that users access their live data. n8n's own guidance is to set up a separate test workflow or test instance, which is a user-side arrangement rather than a product sandbox. The source-control 'Push and pull changes' item says nothing about isolated test environments, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
